His background in complex transactional flows and AI tools aligns well with the focus on payment/billing experiences. The remote U.S. location is preferred, and Principal is an ideal target level.
jobs.jobDescription: Engine, a FinTech company, is seeking a Principal Product Designer to lead their fintech design efforts, focusing on shaping payment and billing experiences and contributing to their first credit card offering. The designer will guide projects from vision to execution within a design culture that includes over 30 designers and cross-functional partners. As a Principal, responsibilities include driving design strategy, leading design reviews, and elevating the craft across the organization. This role requires close partnership with product, engineering, and data teams to deliver impactful features, translating complex ideas into clear, simple flows, and building trust and collaboration while continually improving design quality. Proficiency with Figma, design systems, and emerging AI technologies is expected.

jobs.jobDescription: GitLab, an intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps, is seeking a Staff Product Designer for their Knowledge Graph. This remote U.S. role involves leading the design of cross-cutting platform experiences – foundational elements that impact every workflow within the product. The designer will partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, and other designers to translate ambiguity into clear direction, define solutions, and ship work that significantly improves the experience for developers and DevSecOps teams. Key responsibilities include leading design for complex, ambiguous projects, contributing to the Pajamas Design System, mentoring other designers, and grounding work in user research and feedback. The role emphasizes systems thinking, visual craft, and leveraging AI as a productivity multiplier.
